lead.zh: 第一站挑 4 个地基词，第四站读 8 个原理词。读完说得清大模型为什么这样表现，不再死记硬背。
lead.en: Four foundation terms from station one, eight from station four. Finish able to say why large models behave the way they do.

steps: 大模型 - 大语言模型

zh: 说出 Transformer 处理一句话的大致流程：切词 → 变向量 → 注意力 → 逐词生成
说清聊天模型的训练三阶段，每一阶段各解决什么问题
解释模型为什么会一本正经地编，以及上下文为什么越大越贵
en: Walk through how a Transformer handles a sentence: split, embed, attend, generate one token at a time
Explain the three training stages of a chat model and what each stage solves
Say why a model fabricates confidently, and why bigger context costs more
